create_graph_with_nodes_and_edges: create a Graph instance and add nodes and edges using with_node and with_edge methods
build_plate_hierarchy: build a nested Plate hierarchy inside a Graph using with_plate to group nodes
test_dag_isomorphism: test whether two DAG roots are isomorphic using are_dags_isomorphic on a Graph
merge_isomorphic_nodes: merge isomorphic children of a node using merge_isomorphic_children to reduce graph size
export_graph_to_dot: export a Graph to DOT language format using the to_dot method for visualization
